manifest.coverage: Southern California and northern Baja; complete US/California/Mexico admin relations; regional cuts and contour accuracy unverified; no live border waits
knownLimitations: Road data is from 2026-10-14; US/California administrative members were retrieved 2026-10-16 and may differ at boundary edges.
Regional source coverage is California/Mexico; the bbox is not proof of road coverage in Arizona, Nevada, or beyond the cut.
No timezone database, predicted/live traffic, or real border wait times.
Filled contours use a budget-dependent grid and are not exact graph membership.

sourceGraphProvenance.scope: Read-only hashes of the retained mounted configuration/archive. No build or graph producer rerun.

scope: Post-result descriptive comparison on observed83/35 development cases. Proximity is not road identity/legality or national/area accuracy; full-Census subset excludes coarse base and mixed attachments. Provider speed/profile/source differences and model path choice are confounded; no causal ETA decomposition or new timing policy. Audit time/RSS are offline producer scopes, not app/cloud measurements.
